newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks rise to unofficial record close.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks rise to unofficial record close.

text.p: Mexican stocks held earlier gains to chalk up an unofficial closing record on Tuesday.

Traders and analysts said foreign and domestic investors bought on the prospect of milder-than-expected rises in domestic interest rates amid a confident market outlook over approaching mid-term elections.
Preliminary figures showed the leading IPC share index .MXX closed up 53.26 points, or 1.19 percent, at an unconfirmed record of 4,511.23.
